title: Terms and Conditions
intro: These Terms and Conditions govern the use of this website and the services offered by Aerolab. By using the site or requesting a service, you accept these terms.

sections.heading: 2. Orders and payments
sections.text: Orders placed through the site are processed via an external payment provider. The prices shown are estimates and may vary based on the specific requirements of the project, which are confirmed before work begins.

sections.heading: 3. User accounts

sections.heading: 5. Cancellations and refunds
sections.text: Cancellation requests are evaluated on a case-by-case basis depending on project progress. Work already performed and costs incurred are non-refundable.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of liability
sections.text: Aerolab is not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the services or the website. Services are provided with reasonable care and skill in line with standard industry practices.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to these terms
sections.text: We may update these terms from time to time. Changes take effect as soon as they are published on this page.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.text: If you have questions about these terms, you can reach us through the contact page.
